thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM: I created a remediation watchlist for the streaming/chat endpoint reliability issues. We need explicit owners for three buckets: timeouts (client+server), partial responses detection/mitigation, and reconnect logic. Please reply with ownership + target date.

raj: I can take reconnect logic. Will prototype a safer backoff + jitter change and a small state-machine in the runtime to avoid duplicate resume attempts. Opening design PR today. ETA: end of week (Fri). @maria tagging for visibility. :+1:

eli: I'll own partial-response detection and alerting. Plan is: emit a `partial_response` metric when we close a connection with truncated tokens or when KV cache mismatch is detected, add a retry counter to traces, and wire alerts to PagerDuty if rate > 0.05% over 5m. ETA: Tue next week.

jamie: I'll own timeout testing and client guidance. I'll add e2e tests (local harness + canary) to simulate slow token streaming and ensure SDK docs show recommended retry/backoff. Need infra creds tho — @sarah can you grant `ci-stream-tests` role?

sarah: granted `ci-stream-tests` to jamie. Also logging note: we're still seeing repeated 503s from proxy during hotspot windows. I pulled a short trace sample:

```
[2026-01-17T14:02:33Z] req=0x7f3a2 stream_id=4821 status=partial tokens=128/1024 err=EOF
[2026-01-17T14:02:33Z] req=0x7f3a2 reconnect_attempt=1 route=gpu-pool-3 latency_ms=4350
[2026-01-17T14:02:34Z] req=0x7f3a2 status=closed reason=client_timeout
```

sarah: That pattern (partial then reconnect then client timeout) crops up ~3x during each high-load window. We should add a pulse metric for "incomplete_streams" and hook a dashboard.

maria: Good. I'll capture these as action items in the postmortem tracker. Proposed action list (short IDs):
- A1: Reconnect runtime changes — owner: raj — due: 2026-02-02 — PR: GH #1290
- A2: Partial-response detection + alerting — owner: eli — due: 2026-02-06 — Ticket: REM-2026-78
- A3: Timeout e2e tests + SDK guidance — owner: jamie — due: 2026-02-03 — PR: GH #1294
- A4: Dashboard+alert for incomplete_streams — owner: sarah — due: 2026-02-01 — Dash: infra/streams/incomplete
- A5: Weekly watchlist sync + postmortem update — owner: maria — recurring weekly on Fridays

raj: FYI I started a spike branch. Current TODO in the PR: add circuit breaker for resume attempts and integrate metric `resume_fail_rate`. Ran a quick local load and saw a ~20% reduction in duplicate reconnects but still seeing partials.

eli: For detection I'll add two signals: (1) server-side truncated flag when connection closed before EOS, (2) KV-cache size mismatch at reconnect. Both will be tagged with model/version. Will push a small telemetry-only change first to validate signal quality.

jamie: Test plan note: will create a harness job `ci/stream-timeouts` to run against canary and dedicated pools at different qps. Will add a gating check that fails PRs touching streaming runtime until tests pass.

maria: Two process asks: (1) Please add the ticket numbers to the PM tracker rows (REM-2026-78 etc). (2) Anyone who needs extra runway, call it out now.

raj: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1290 — opened. Marking WIP until load tests pass. If tests look flaky I may request an extra week.

eli: Creating ticket REM-2026-78 and linking to the postmortem. Also adding sample logs and expected metric thresholds to the ticket.

incident-bot: Created ticket REM-2026-78 and linked to thread by maria. Assigned to eli.

maria: Calendar: setting recurring "Streaming reliability watchlist" Fridays 10:00-10:30 PT, first one this Friday. Invite sent to participants.

sarah: I'll add the dashboard in Grafana and create alert `Alert:IncompleteStreamsHigh` with a 5m window and notify #oncall if > 0.03% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: planned canary deploy of runtime changes on 2026-02-01 02:00 UTC. Will run A/B traffic 10%/90% for 2h.

maria: Thanks everyone. Let's use this thread as the single source for remediation status updates — post short status lines only. I'll update the PM doc after our first sync. :shipit:

raj: STATUS 2026-01-21: PR still WIP, load tests failing at 75% qps. Investigating race in resume path.

eli: STATUS 2026-01-22: telemetry-only change pushed to canary, initial signal looks clean, opening follow-up PR for automated alerting.

jamie: STATUS 2026-01-22: `ci/stream-timeouts` job added, running hourly against canary. One flaky test observed; flake ticket opened GH #1301.

maria: STATUS 2026-01-23: all action items entered in tracker and linked to the postmortem. Next sync Friday 10:00 PT.

incident-bot: Reminder: weekly watchlist sync today at 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime patch to canary at 2026-01-24T02:00Z (10% traffic). Monitoring metrics for `resume_fail_rate` and `incomplete_streams`.
